Name: Simple Waystones (Big Update)
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]✦ Simple Waystones ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b][color=#A7F3D0]Build your network. Uncover every style. Let the final stone surprise you.[/color][/b][/center]
[center]Build an Ancient Waystone with Robin, then place smaller stones at your favourite outdoor destinations. Collect sixteen mystery styles, name your stops and travel between them without gold or energy fees. Complete the collection for a special black random-travel stone.[/center]
[center]Cropped Town placement preview: Forest and the black collection reward. Uses the native Town map and actual mod draw; an isolated renderer preview, not an installed-save gameplay screenshot.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]🌿 Start with Robin[/color]
[/b][/size][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52377/52377-1791486706-934576696.png[/img][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Unlock[/color][/b]
[b]Details:[/b] Reach Mining level 6 and Mines floor 120. Robin sends an invitation.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Gold[/color][/b]
[b]Details:[/b] 75,000g[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Materials[/color][/b]
[b]Details:[/b] 1,000 Stone + 100 Refined Quartz + 5 Fire Quartz[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Construction[/color][/b]
[b]Details:[/b] Two days[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Next step[/color][/b]
[b]Details:[/b] Once the hub is finished, buy one Mystery Waystone per farm per day from Robin.[/quote][/center]
[center]Place portable stones on supported permanent outdoor maps. Keep clear arrival ground beside each stone.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]🎁 One mystery purchase each day[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Robin's shop displays a [b]black Mystery Waystone with a golden question mark[/b]. Buy it to immediately reveal a style you have not purchased before. There are [b]sixteen unique styles[/b], with no repeated styles from the mystery purchases.[/center]
[center]You can buy [b]one per farm per calendar day[/b]. Come back another day for the next stone. Stock refreshes each day; your rising purchase price continues across days. The collection sells out once all sixteen have been purchased. Every style works in any supported outdoor destination; its theme does not restrict it to a matching region.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]💰 Regular or Balanced — separate downloads[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]First stone[/color][/b]
[b]Regular:[/b] 25,000g
[b]Balanced:[/b] 150,000g[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Increase each time[/color][/b]
[b]Regular:[/b] +25,000g
[b]Balanced:[/b] +150,000g[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Second stone[/color][/b]
[b]Regular:[/b] 50,000g
[b]Balanced:[/b] 300,000g[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Eighth stone[/color][/b]
[b]Regular:[/b] 200,000g
[b]Balanced:[/b] 1,200,000g[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Sixteenth stone[/color][/b]
[b]Regular:[/b] 400,000g
[b]Balanced:[/b] 2,400,000g[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]All sixteen[/color][/b]
[b]Regular:[/b] 3,400,000g
[b]Balanced:[/b] 20,400,000g[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Including farm hub[/color][/b]
[b]Regular:[/b] 3,475,000g
[b]Balanced:[/b] 20,475,000g[/quote][/center]
[center]Construction materials are additional. The black collection reward is free in both editions.
Daily stock refreshes; the purchase counter and rising price do not reset.
Install one edition at a time. Balanced is a separate download, not a GMCM checkbox.[/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Main File: Simple Waystones[/color][/b]
Regular starts at 25,000g and adds 25,000g after every successful purchase.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Optional File: Simple Waystones (Balanced)[/color][/b]
Balanced starts at 150,000g and adds 150,000g after every successful purchase. It includes the same collection, artwork, travel features and recovery mail.[/quote][/center]
[center][b]Install one edition at a time.[/b] Both use the same SimpleWaystones folder and save identity. You can switch editions while keeping existing stones, custom names, favourites, purchase progress and recovery state. Only future purchase prices change. Balanced is [b]not a GMCM checkbox[/b] in version 1.2.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]✨ Sixteen collectible styles[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52377/52377-1791486728-471584410.png[/img][/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]All sixteen purchased styles at the same native size, shown as Town crops. Assembled from actual map and Waystone draws in an isolated renderer. The black reward is additional.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]🖤 One final surprise from Robin[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Purchase all sixteen styles and Robin gives you one [b]Black Mystery Waystone[/b]. It goes into your inventory, or drops beside your farmer if the inventory is full.[/center]
[center]Place it outdoors and interact to start travel to a [b]random safe, available Waystone destination you have already visited[/b]. There is no destination menu, confirmation prompt or travel fee. It chooses from your existing network, so it does not unlock unexplored areas.[/center]
[center]Other stones can travel back to the black stone through the ordinary menu. The completed network has [b]eighteen possible destinations[/b]: the farm hub, sixteen purchased portable stones and the black reward.[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52377/52377-1791486749-949781072.png[/img][/center]
[center]The extra placeable black reward in a cropped Town scene. Interact with it to begin random travel without choosing a destination. Isolated native renderer preview.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🧭 A comfortable travel menu[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Name and rename your destinations, search the list, mark personal favourites, scroll smoothly or drag the scrollbar. Each row shows the stone’s artwork and style. Move portable stones with an axe or pickaxe while keeping their names.[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52377/52377-1791486764-950223801.png[/img][/center]
[center]Actual travel-menu render with destination search, personal favourites, style icons and a draggable scrollbar. The displayed destinations are a demonstration network.[/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Mouse and controller controls[/color][/b]
[b]Mouse:[/b] Select a destination to travel; click its star to toggle a favourite; use the wheel or scrollbar to browse.
[b]Controller:[/b] Move through the list with the directional controls; A selects, Y toggles the selected favourite, LB/RB scroll and B closes.
[b]Keyboard:[/b] Select the search field to type; Page Up/Page Down scroll.[/quote][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]🎨 HD or Vanilla artwork[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b]HD artwork is enabled by default.[/b] Turn on [b]Use Vanilla sprites[/b] in GMCM for the original eight portable sprites and farm hub, alongside the new pixel styles and black reward. This changes appearance, not stone size, placement, ownership or travel. Loaded replacement artwork from other mods takes priority over the HD routing.[/center]
[center]The same Town placement with Use Vanilla sprites enabled. Isolated native renderer preview.[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52377/52377-1791486785-1398369112.png[/img][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Use Vanilla sprites[/color][/b]
[b]Default and effect:[/b] Off. HD is the default; turn on for the original eight sprites and hub plus the additional pixel styles.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Rune glow[/color][/b]
[b]Default and effect:[/b] On. Gently brighten the rune carvings.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Rune pulse[/color][/b]
[b]Default and effect:[/b] On. Slowly brighten and fade the rune glow. Requires Rune glow.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Particles[/color][/b]
[b]Default and effect:[/b] On. Small themed motes and travel particles.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Ground light[/color][/b]
[b]Default and effect:[/b] On. A small theme-coloured light around nearby stones.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Activation rings[/color][/b]
[b]Default and effect:[/b] On. A brief expanding ring during departure and arrival.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Waystone sounds[/color][/b]
[b]Default and effect:[/b] On. Reveal, charge and arrival sounds.[/quote][/center]
[center]Save applies your staged choices; Cancel keeps your saved settings.
Without GMCM, use the generated config.json for these artwork and effect switches.[/center]
[center][color=#67E8F9][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/color] is optional. Open its settings and choose [b]Simple Waystones[/b] or [b]Simple Waystones (Balanced)[/b], matching the installed edition.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52377/52377-1791486859-1521967110.png[/img][/center]
[center]Actual populated GMCM 1.16.0 page for Regular 1.2. Seven artwork and effect checkboxes; no Balance checkbox.[/center]
[center]Actual populated GMCM 1.16.0 page for Balanced 1.2. The title identifies the installed edition; pricing is fixed by that edition.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]📬 “You lost this!”[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]If a purchased portable stone or the awarded black stone goes missing, Robin returns it in mail the next morning. The mod checks native inventories, chests, placed stones and loose items before sending a replacement. Pending letters prevent repeat replacements; if the original reappears before you open a letter, its stale attachment is removed.[/center]
[center]Recovery keeps purchase progress, prices and a stone's last observed custom name and identity. Missing old generic stones with prepaid conversion credits can also be returned. Recovery applies to portable stones; the farm building is not an inventory item. Custom storage hidden from the game's item traversal remains unverified.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]📜 Travel while away from a stone[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Waystone Scroll recipe — makes one[/color][/b]
[b]Materials:[/b] 50 Fiber + 5 Refined Quartz + 5 Stone.
[b]Use:[/b] Activate a Scroll to choose a known Waystone while away from a stone.
[b]Consumption:[/b] Only after successful travel.
[b]Stone-to-stone travel:[/b] No Scroll, gold fee or energy cost.[/quote][/center]
[center]The Scroll recipe arrives when the farm hub is finished. Portable stones require supported permanent outdoor maps with clear ground for arrival. Travel retains cutscene, festival, temporary-map and interrupted-travel safeguards.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]📦 Requirements and installation[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b]Required:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and [color=#67E8F9][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI 4.5.2 or later[/url][/color].
[b]Optional:[/b] Generic Mod Config Menu. No separate shared-library mod is needed.[/center]
[center]1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download either Regular or Balanced and extract the ZIP.
3. Place the extracted [b]SimpleWaystones[/b] folder in your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder.
4. Launch through SMAPI.[/center]
[center]Install the extracted folder, not the ZIP. When updating or switching editions, keep your config.json and replace the existing SimpleWaystones files with your chosen edition. Keep only one copy installed and restart the game.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🔄 Updating an existing network[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Existing stone and building IDs, saved names, placed positions and purchases are retained. Earlier purchases count towards your next price. Old prepaid generic stones can be exchanged at Robin for a mystery style without paying again, using one conversion credit and that day’s stock. A saved version 1.1 BalanceMode config entry is ignored in 1.2; choose the separate Balanced download for those prices.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]🧩 Compatibility and languages[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Multiplayer remains experimental. Every player should use the same version and edition. The host handles construction, purchases and recovery mail; players share the placed network. Full interactive multiplayer, split-screen, physical-controller and expansion-modpack playtesting remain unverified.[/center]
[center]Twelve earlier language files are included. Newly added text currently uses English through SMAPI’s normal fallback. Isolated native rendering and purchase, settings, recovery and travel checks have passed; these are not a full in-game playtest.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]🎨 Artwork and credits[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Custom Waystone artwork was made with AI assistance and prepared for the mod’s native sprite bounds. Stardew Valley and its original artwork belong to ConcernedApe. The Town and interface images on this page use the native game map/assets with the actual mod and installed GMCM renderer in isolated previews; no real save was modified to make them.[/center]
